name: Sylph Industries Limited
about: Sylph Industries Limited, a software technology company, provides software development services and solutions in India. The company offers IT software hardware, is a generic IT setups, including hardware installations, network configuration, server deployment, and cloud integration; real estate development involves the planning, financing, and construction of residential, commercial, and industrial properties, such as weekend villas, warehouses, community villas, commercial residential, and hotel industry; chemical industry involves the production and transformation of raw materials into essential products used in agriculture, healthcare, manufacturing, and daily life, includes the development of industrial chemicals, specialty chemicals, and consumer chemicals through advanced research and processes; fmcg exports involve the international distribution of fast-moving consumer goods such as food, beverages, personal care, and household products; clean energy, is a power generated from renewable, environmentally friendly sources like solar, wind, hydro, and geothermal; and solid and waste water management involves the treatment and disposal of sewage, industrial effluents, and solid waste to protect public health and the environment. The company also offers mobiles, includes mobile marketing solutions, mobile campaigns, mobile wap site, messaging solutions, and m-commerce solutions. In addition, the company offers barrel, includes Drum Manufacturing; waste energy services, such as incineration, gasification, anaerobic digestion, and pyrolysis to recover energy from solid, organic, and industrial waste; and trading of commodities, such as iron and steel, tubes and bars, cast iron products, steel pipes and fittings, and casting & forging materials. It serves retail, brand marketing, manufacturing, communication, education and training, and digital media markets. The company was formerly known as Sylph Technologies limited and changed its name to Sylph Industries Limited in October 2025. The company was incorporated in 1992 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
